title: Align Logic Pro mixer parameter contracts
problem: logic_mixer advertises track/value, but set_volume and set_pan translate them into keys that neither OSC nor Accessibility accepts. set_master_volume routes to two channels that do not implement it, so all three public commands always fail.
reproduce: At pinned revision bdc105e7, exercise the documented set_volume, set_pan, and set_master_volume contracts. The dispatcher/channel contract check fails with MIXER_PARAMETER_CONTRACT_BROKEN; the reporter also reproduced all three failures over the released stdio MCP server.
acceptance: set_volume and set_pan preserve track/value through the dispatcher and both backends; set_master_volume reaches a real Accessibility handler that selects Master, with Stereo Out only when no separate master strip exists. Focused Swift tests cover each reported command.
repair: Use the documented track/value names end to end, implement master fader selection through the existing Accessibility mixer tree, remove the unsupported OSC master route, and add dispatcher regressions.

verification.limitations: BCL proves an exact baseline-red/candidate-green contract and the candidate builds in Swift release mode. The upstream macOS CI awaits maintainer approval for a first-time fork, and changing a live Logic Pro mixer remains the owner check.
verification.ownerCheck: With the mixer visible and Accessibility permission granted, call set_volume and set_pan on a noncritical test track, then set_master_volume. Confirm the intended track controls and Master fader move to the requested values; if no separate Master strip exists, confirm Stereo Out moves.

selection.reason: A fresh report provides live logs and exact code locations for three always-failing advertised commands. The defect is deterministic, the patch is focused, and no competing PR exists.

upstream.suiteOutputIncludes: PASS: mixer parameter contract is aligned end to end
